title: Fine-Tuned Small Language Model for Synthetic Clinical Data Generation and Predictive Healthcare Analytics
abstract: arXiv:2611.16460v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The reduced availability of medical datasets represents an important challenge in the development of predictive models for remote healthcare solutions, especially when the available data are imbalanced or difficult to extend through traditional methods. Small Language Models (SLMs) have become a promising alternative to Large Language Models (LLMs) for addressing these limitations due to their lower computational requirements and adaptability to specialized tasks. However, their performance remains highly dependent on the quality and representativeness of the available training data. In this paper, we propose a method for clinical data augmentation based on a fine-tuned Microsoft Phi-2 model that is used to generate synthetic instances, with the purpose of improving deep learning-based model for predicting remotely monitored vital signs. The Phi-2 model was adapted to the medical domain through supervised fine-tuning on the MedQuad datas

translated_title: 微调小语言模型用于合成临床数据生成与预测性医疗分析
translated_abstract: 医疗数据集可获得性的降低是远程医疗解决方案预测模型开发中的一个重要挑战，特别是当可用数据不平衡或难以通过传统方法进行扩展时。小语言模型（SLMs）由于其较低的计算需求和对专业任务的适应性，已成为解决这些局限性的大语言模型（LLMs）的有前景的替代方案。然而，其性能仍然高度依赖于可用训练数据的质量和代表性。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于微调微软Phi-2模型的临床数据增强方法，该方法用于生成合成实例，旨在改进基于深度学习的远程监测生命体征预测模型。Phi-2模型通过在MedQuad数据集上进行监督微调来适应医疗领域。
tldr: 本文提出通过对微软Phi-2小语言模型进行监督微调来生成合成临床数据，以增强医疗数据集并改进远程监测生命体征的深度学习预测模型。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a fine-tuned Microsoft Phi-2 small language model for generating synthetic clinical data to augment medical datasets and improve deep learning-based prediction of remotely monitored vital signs.
